fields.climate: tropical; hot, humid; dry, northeast monsoon (November to March); rainy, southwest monsoon (June to August)
fields.terrain: flat coral atolls, with white sandy beaches; sits atop the submarine volcanic Chagos-Laccadive Ridge
fields.hazards: tsunamis; low elevation of islands makes them sensitive to sea level rise
fields.farm: fruits, vegetables, nuts, other meats, papayas, bananas, tomatoes, maize, pulses, chillies/peppers
fields.exports: fish, aircraft, refined petroleum, scrap iron, natural gas
fields.industries: tourism, fish processing, shipping, boat building, coconut processing, woven mats, rope, handicrafts, coral and sand mining
fields.languages: Dhivehi (official, closely related to Sinhala, script derived from Arabic), English (spoken by most government officials)
fields.legal: Islamic (sharia) legal system with English common law influences, primarily in commercial matters
fields.military: 18-25 years of age for voluntary service; no conscription
